name: Zonos Checkout for Woocommerce
author: zonos

sections.description:
Key Features

  1. International Checkout Button – Adds an international checkout option to the standard WooCommerce checkout flow
  2. Zonos Hello – Provides a solution where you can greet shoppers in their language, inform them about duties, taxes, and more.
  3. Order Synchronization – Maintains order status and tracking information between WooCommerce and Zonos
  4. Product Mapping – Maps WooCommerce product data to Zonos requirements
  5. Webhook Integration – Enables real-time updates for order status and tracking information

How It Works

The plugin acts as a bridge between WooCommerce and the Zonos platform. When an international customer visits the store, they can click the “International Checkout” button which sends the cart data to Zonos. The customer completes their purchase through the Zonos checkout interface, which handles currency conversion, duty and tax calculation, and shipping options. Once the order is completed in Zonos, it’s imported back into WooCommerce for order management and fulfillment.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.2+
  • WooCommerce
  • PHP 8.1+
  • Zonos API Keys (available at Zonos Dashboard)

Documentation

For customer documentation, visit Zonos Documentation

External Services

This plugin connects to external services provided by Zonos to enable international checkout functionality:

Zonos Platform
– Service Purpose: Provides international checkout processing, duty and tax calculation, currency conversion, and shipping options for international customers.
– Data Transmission: When a customer clicks the “International Checkout” button, the following data is sent to Zonos servers:
– Cart contents (product information, quantities, prices)
– Customer information (when provided during checkout)
– Store information necessary for processing orders
– When Data is Sent: Data is sent when customers initiate the international checkout process and during order synchronization between WooCommerce and Zonos.
– Terms of Service: Zonos Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy: Zonos Privacy Policy

Zonos API
– Service Purpose: Enables communication between your WooCommerce store and the Zonos platform for order synchronization, product mapping, and webhook integration.
– Data Transmission: API calls exchange order status, tracking information, and product data between your WooCommerce store and Zonos.
– When Data is Sent: During initial setup, order processing, status updates, and when products are added or modified in your store.
– Terms of Service: Zonos Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy: Zonos Privacy Policy
